### A New Commandment from Christ
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/new-commandment-from-christ
Passage: John 13:34-35
Points:
- Jesus prepared his disciples for his absence by commanding them to love one another.
- The command is new because the standard is now Christ's own self-giving love.
- This love remains steadfast even when others wrong or betray us, just as Jesus forgave Peter.
- Sacrificial love among believers serves as the distinguishing mark of true discipleship before the world.

### Journey With Jesus: A New Commandment
Author: K.P. Yohannan
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/spiritual-life/journey-with-jesus-a-new-commandment-1297456.html
Passage: John 13:34-35
Points:
- Jesus established love as the bedrock of discipleship right before his departure.
- Christ demonstrated unconditional love by extending mercy and restoration to disciples who failed him.
- Following this commandment requires self-denial and paying a personal cost to serve others.
- Believers receive the power to love difficult people by dwelling in Christ's presence and grace.
